title: Access levels and RMF
snippet: The Google Ads API is free to use; there are no charges for using the Google Ads API at Explorer access, Basic access, or Standard access levels. However, if you are subject to [Required Minimum Functionality (RMF)](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/api-policy/rmf), the API Review Team audits your tool for compliance. If the audit results in a finding of non-compliance, you may be required to pay [non-compliance fees](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/api-policy/non-compliance-fee).

title: Google Ads API comprehensive onboarding guide
snippet:
## 2. Obtain a developer token
The developer token uniquely identifies your application to the Google Ads API and controls your call volume access tier.
### Steps to apply
1. Sign in to your **Google Ads Manager Account**.
2. Navigate to **Tools and settings > Setup > API Center** (or **Admin > API Center**).
3. Fill out the developer details form and agree to the API Terms of Service.
4. Submit your application.
### Access levels
- **Pending Approval:** Newly created tokens immediately receive a "Pending" status. You can use a pending token to connect to **Test Accounts** immediately, but it will not work against production accounts.
- **Basic Access:** Allows up to 15,000 API operations per day once approved.
- **Standard Access:** Unlimited daily API operations for applications that meet the Required Minimum Functionality (RMF).

### Pricing and billing note
- **No API Fees:** Creating a Google Cloud project, enabling the Google Ads API, and generating OAuth 2.0 credentials is **100% free**. Google does not charge any fees for calling or using the Google Ads API itself.
- **Other Cloud Resources:** You will only incur Google Cloud fees if you actively use other billable Google Cloud services (such as Compute Engine, Cloud Run, or BigQuery) beyond their Free Tier limits to host your application or store your ad data.

title: Google Ads API: Access Levels, Costs and Setup (2026)
snippet:
The Google Ads API lets you read account data and change campaigns programmatically, whether from your own scripts or from a workflow tool like [Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com), and it **costs nothing per call**.
It needs three things before a request works: a developer token, OAuth credentials and a Google Ads account.
Google issues the approval for the token, and **no route around that exists**. Checked against Google's developer documentation on 1 Nov 2026.

You will not be billed per call: Google doesn't charge for Google Ads API requests. The price of a request is zero.
That's not the same as "free of limits": usage is still governed by quotas and access levels tied to your developer token. A call can fail on a quota without ever costing you money.
When a request is rejected, the error response says which limit you hit, and that's the part worth reading closely.

*Prices and plan limits checked against [docs.claude.com](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview) and [claude.com](https://claude.com/pricing) and [openai.com](https://openai.com/chatgpt/pricing) and [gemini.google](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) on October 31, 2026.*

| Access level | Daily operations | Account reach | Approval | Review time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Test | no figure published | Test accounts only | None beyond the token | no figure published |
| Explorer | 2,880 | Production accounts | Application reviewed by Google | no figure published |
| Basic | 15,000 | Production accounts | Application reviewed by Google | no figure published |
| Standard | no figure published | Production accounts | Application reviewed by Google | no figure published |

The free plan is $0 with 1,000 credits a month and unlimited flows, so the same weekly flow fits there too.
